name: r15_fwd360
expression: f = forward_price_360 / close; group_zscore(winsorize(ts_mean(f, 20), std=3.0), industry)

name: r15_volterm_slow
expression: t = implied_volatility_mean_30 / implied_volatility_mean_360; group_zscore(winsorize(-ts_mean(t, 20), std=3.0), industry)

name: r15_assetgrowth
expression: a = ts_backfill(assets, 60); g = ts_delta(a, 250) / a; group_zscore(winsorize(-g, std=3.0), industry)
